_comment: Standing answers for application forms. Copy to applicant.json and fill in. Gitignored, because this is your personal data and it never leaves your machine.

compensation._comment: Per lane, because the markets differ. `default` is used when the lane is unknown.

voluntary._comment: US EEO questions. Every value here may be the literal string 'decline' and ALYX will select the decline-to-answer option. Nothing here is ever required to submit an application.

documents._comment: Default resume used when no tailored one has been built for the role. Path relative to the repo root, or absolute.
